title: MPLX LP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: MPLX LP entered into a new $2.5 billion five-year unsecured revolving credit facility with Wells Fargo as administrative agent, replacing its prior $2.0 billion credit agreement dated July 2022. The new facility matures April 7, 2031, includes sub-facilities for swing-line loans and letters of credit, and carries commitment fees of 10-25 bps on unused amounts depending on credit ratings. As of March 31, 2026, MPLX held $1.5 billion in cash with no borrowings outstanding under either agreement.
key_points: MPLX LP entered into a $2.5 billion unsecured revolving credit agreement on April 7, 2026, replacing the prior $2.0 billion facility from July 2022
New credit facility matures April 7, 2031 with option for two one-year extensions subject to lender consent
No borrowings were outstanding under the 2022 Credit Agreement at termination; MPLX had $1.5 billion cash as of March 31, 2026
Facility includes swing-line loans up to $150 million and letters of credit up to $150 million (expandable to $200 million)
Commitment fees range from 10 to 25 basis points depending on MPLX's credit ratings
Debt-to-EBITDA covenant requires ratio not to exceed 5.0x (or 5.5x during acquisition periods)
Facility syndicate includes Wells Fargo, JPMorgan, Barclays, BofA, Citi, Goldman Sachs, Mizuho, MUFG, RBC, SMBC, and TD Securities
